breakdown.description: The prompt uses the polar moment J in the Euler buckling formula, even though Euler buckling depends on the flexural second moment I.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully corrected the use of the polar moment of inertia (J). While it acknowledged J, it correctly specified that the Euler expression uses the second moment of area (I) and provided the correct formula I = π d⁴ / 64 for the calculation, thus avoiding the error in the original prompt.

breakdown.description: The prompt multiplies the critical load by the factor of safety to obtain the allowable load, whereas the allowable load should be the critical load divided by the factor of safety.
breakdown.reason: The agent successfully corrected the definition of the allowable load. The original prompt incorrectly stated to multiply by the factor of safety (n * P_cr), but the agent correctly changed this to division (P_allow = P_cr / n), aligning with the ground truth.
